title: AutoCAD parity certification
objective: Certify integrated AutoCAD-class professional workflows against a representative workflow corpus without changing ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: A representative professional workflow corpus is defined and version-pinned before certification evidence is produced.
Representative workflows pass semantics and behavioral-fidelity assessment against declared AutoCAD reference behavior.
Representative workflows pass persistence and round-trip durability assessment with deterministic canonical identities and lineage.
Representative workflows are completed through real Web/Electron UI paths rather than API-only mocks.
Interoperability is assessed with explicit EXACT, LOSSY and UNSUPPORTED outcomes and no fabricated semantics.
Performance and robustness are assessed against declared corpus-specific targets and recorded as revision-bound evidence.
Feature checklist presence alone is explicitly insufficient for certification.
Construction Graph, CADDocument, App API, command registry and native engine/worker boundaries remain unchanged and respected.
Existing verified CAD/BIM regressions remain green and pinned fixtures remain byte-identical where applicable.
Certification evidence is reproducible, revision-bound and sufficient for an Architect VERIFIED decision.
non_goals: Claiming unrestricted or perfect AutoCAD feature parity.
Adding unrelated AutoCAD features solely to increase checklist coverage.
Changing Architecture v1.1 without an Architecture Change Request.
Replacing the Construction Graph or CADDocument authority model.
Bypassing the established engine adapter or worker boundary.
risk_assumptions: P018 is VERIFIED and provides the specialized professional toolset baseline.
COMPAT-CAD-004 is completed and VERIFIED before P019 execution.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout certification.
Reference workflow expectations are documented and reproducible enough to support certification claims.
evidence_requirements: Version-pinned representative AutoCAD workflow corpus and reference expectations.
Deterministic semantic-fidelity results for the declared corpus.
Persistence and round-trip evidence for representative workflows.
Interop evidence with explicit EXACT/LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED classification.
Regression proof over verified CAD/BIM baselines.
Exact-head CI verification and deployment/browser evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering certification implementation, review and final verification.

transitions.reason: P019 is fully specified as the next certification milestone on the authoritative roadmap. Its dependencies P018 and COMPAT-CAD-004 are VERIFIED, Architecture v1.1 is frozen, the certification acceptance/evidence contract is explicit, and the corpus-first certification boundary is preserved.

The Product Owner's 'next' authorization advances P019 into execution. Assign the certification work to the logical implementation agent with the implementation-side stop gate at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING. The agent must first establish and version-pin the representative corpus and its reference expectations before certification claims are made.

Begin the CAD-PARITY-019 AutoCAD parity certification implementation on the released baseline: the certification-first execution rule applies — the version-pinned representative AutoCAD professional workflow corpus and its reference expectations are defined and pinned BEFORE any certification evidence is produced; then the deterministic certification engine (semantics, persistence round-trip, real-UI command-stream completion, explicit EXACT/LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED interop, performance/robustness) is implemented against that corpus, with the app-suite certification test, the Web/Electron host-parity convergence, the web-host certification smoke and the Certification workbench. Architecture v1.1 stays frozen (the Construction Graph, CADDocument, App API, command registry and engine/worker boundaries unchanged); the implementation-side stop gate remains PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.

The certification implementation is complete at the PR head: the version-pinned corpus (the first deliverable), the deterministic certification engine, the app-suite certification test with the pinned fixture, the Web/Electron host-parity convergence, the NINETEENTH web certification smoke and the Certification workbench. The governance gates at the record tree are green (validate 503/503, check-protected PASS, check-verified-revisions PASS, the root suite 199/199, the full app suite 1330 pass / 0 fail).

Submit CAD-PARITY-019 for verification: EV-001 (the full app suite incl. the three CAD-PARITY-019 certification tests) and EV-002 (the pinned certification fixture + the byte-identical cross-host parity through the in-process basis, both host transports and the real web app) are recorded; the exact-head CI matrix + the dispatch run and the exact-head deployment + the deployed certification smoke + the browser verification follow per the P016/P017/P018 discipline and will be bound in the PR evidence comments. The hard implementation-side stop gate: no self-approval, no self-verification — ARCHITECT_REVIEW → APPROVED → VERIFIED belong to the Architect.

evidence.description: The full deterministic app suite at the implementation head: 1375 tests, 1330 pass, 0 fail, 45 skipped (the OCCT-gated suites run in CI with the pinned toolchains — the dedicated cad-parity-019 workflow installs OCCT 7.8.1.1 + ifcopenshell 0.8.5 + IfcTester 0.8.5). The +3 CAD-PARITY-019 tests: the app-suite AutoCAD parity certification (the version-pinned corpus autocad-p019-corpus/1 through the REAL App API handler + the shared prompt-engine command registry — 8/8 workflows, 100 declared reference expectations with the honest outcome spread 96 exact / 4 typed-unsupported, 13 live interop probes 6 exact / 1 lossy / 6 unsupported, zero failures, verdict CERTIFIED), the Web/Electron host-parity convergence (the same corpus through both hosts' REAL transports — byte-identical certification verdicts), and the corpus invariant test (the first-deliverable version pin is well-formed and deterministic).
evidence.reproduction: cd app && OFFISOS_PYTHON=<python with ifcopenshell 0.8.5 + IfcTester 0.8.5> node --import tsx --test 'test/*.test.ts'

evidence.description: The pinned certification fixture (app/test/fixtures/cad-parity-019-certification.json, the basis-excluded deterministic verdict projection sha256 db8d304ed251d210051a68a2b002f8261d9360db5759db19348ac07899d69c92) + the cross-host parity proof: the SAME version-pinned corpus produces the byte-identical verdict projection through (a) the in-process App API handler (the app-suite test), (b) the Web host's WebSocketTransport and the Electron host's IpcTransport (the autocad-p019-host-parity test), and (c) the REAL web app over HTTP (the NINETEENTH smoke, apps/web/test/certification-p019-smoke.mjs, run against the running dev server with the reference adapter + the pinned IfcOpenShell interop adapter — the wall-clock perf budgets asserted per workflow and never pinned).
